strings.name: Kylian Mbappé
strings.summary: Born in Paris and raised in Bondy, Mbappé trained at Clairefontaine and Monaco before playing for PSG and Real Madrid. He won the 2018 World Cup with France, scored a hat-trick in the 2022 final and won the Golden Boot in 2022 and 2026. Known for speed, runs and finishing, his achievements depend on teamwork.
strings.influence.rationale: World Cup champion and pivotal finals player, representing a new generation of global football stars.
strings.highlights.h1.title: World Cup champion
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won with France in 2018, scoring against Croatia in the final.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Two World Cup Golden Boots
strings.highlights.h2.text: Tournament top scorer with eight goals in 2022 and ten in 2026.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Another World Cup Golden Boot
strings.timeline.t1.text: Scored ten goals at the 2026 World Cup to win the Golden Boot.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joined Real Madrid
strings.timeline.t2.text: Left PSG for club football in Spain with Real Madrid.
strings.timeline.t3.title: World Cup final hat-trick
strings.timeline.t3.text: Scored three against Argentina in the final; France lost the shootout.
strings.timeline.t4.title: World title with France
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won the 2018 title at his first senior World Cup.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Joined PSG
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joined initially on loan before completing a permanent transfer.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Monaco league title
strings.timeline.t6.text: Helped Monaco win the 2016–2017 Ligue 1 title.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First-team debut
strings.timeline.t7.text: Made his Monaco first-team debut, beginning his senior professional career.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Paris
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Paris, raised in Bondy, where he began football training.
